When a customer upgrades mid-cycle, they pay the difference for the days left in the period.

An upgrade takes effect straight away. The customer is charged the new price minus the old one, for the days left in the current billing period, and the next renewal is at the new price. A downgrade takes effect at the end of the period, so no credit is issued.
